name: Agency name
addText: Your agency is free. Pilotix checks it before it works with stores.
signupText: Your agency confirms and follows your sellers’ orders, with your own team. Free: Pilotix checks the agency before it starts.
sellersHelp: The stores your agency works for. Open one to see its numbers, its prices and who works for it.
addSellerText: Type the store’s code (the seller finds it in Settings or Agencies). They get your request and accept it.
notVerifiedYet: Pilotix has not checked your agency yet: you can send requests after that.
alreadyActive: You already work for this store.
alreadyPending: A request is already waiting for an answer.

taskHelp.confirmation: Call the customers and confirm the orders
taskHelp.suivi: Follow the parcels until they are delivered
taskHelp.marketing: Run the ads of the products given

pricesForText: Your usual prices are already filled in: change them for this store if you want.
storeAsks: This store wants to work with your agency:
yourPrices: Your prices (the ones the store saw)
allProductsHelp: Products added later too. A product given to another agency goes to that agency.
someProductsHelp: Only these products. The others stay with your team.
agentsHelp: They work on this seller’s orders from the agency’s space, with their roles.
chooseAgentsText: Tick the people of your team who work for this seller. Their products are chosen in Users.
noAgentText: No agent: choose who works for this store.
noTeamYet: Nobody in your team for this work. Add agents in
pricesHelpAgency: Only you set your prices. A change waits for the store’s “yes”: the old prices stay until then.
newPricesSent: New prices sent: the store must say yes
pricesChangeRule: The store keeps the current prices until it accepts the new ones (or ends the contract).
pricesProposed: New prices sent to the store

p.bonusRate: Bonus for a good delivery rate

ph.perDelivered: The most common: paid when the customer received it.
ph.perConfirmed: Paid as soon as the order is confirmed.
ph.perUpsell: For each delivered order with an extra product.
ph.perSuccess: An ad set the store judges “successful” (Marketing › Marketer), in the month it stops.
ph.profitRate: A % of your ad sets’ net profit for the month (after ads), when it is positive.

billEmpty: Nothing to pay for this month.
paymentsHelpAgency: You ask to be paid for a month; the store pays outside Pilotix and notes it; you confirm when the money arrived.
endTextAgency: Your team will no longer see this seller’s orders. Unfinished orders go back to their team.
endTextStore: The agency will no longer see your orders. Unfinished orders come back to your team.

home.waitText: Prepare your prices and your team now. As soon as Pilotix has checked the agency, you can work with sellers.
home.codeText: Give this code to sellers: they find you with it and send you their request.

home.waiting_other: {{count}} sellers are waiting for your answer
home.monthHelp: Counted by Pilotix in each store: orders received, confirmed, delivered, and what the store owes you with your prices.
home.noSeller: No seller yet. Add one with their code.
home.whereText: Your agency gave you these stores. Open one to confirm or follow its orders.
home.noWhere: Your agency has not given you a seller yet.

team.title: Your team
team.help: The people of your agency. Then choose who works for each seller (Sellers page).
team.text: What you pay your agents stays with you: sellers never see it.
team.name: Name
team.pwText: Give it to the person. They can change it in My profile.

tarifs.title: Your usual prices
tarifs.help: What sellers see before working with you. For one seller you can write other prices.
tarifs.text: Put 0 for a part you do not use. Only you set your prices: the seller accepts or refuses.
tarifs.exampleHelp: To see what your prices give (an example, not a real seller).

store.codeHelp: A confirmation agency or a marketer types this code to send you a request.
store.codeText: Give this code to a confirmation agency: it sends you a request, you accept it.
store.addText: Type the agency’s code (AG-…). You see its prices, then you choose the work and the products you give it.
store.theirPricesText: Prices are set by the agency: you accept or you refuse.
store.noPriceYet: This agency has not written its prices yet.
store.alreadyActive: This agency already works for you.
store.agencyAsks: This agency wants to work for you:
store.agenciesHelp: The agencies that confirm or follow your orders. An order goes to an agency by its first product.
store.none: No agency yet. Add one with its code.
store.noAgentYet: the agency has not chosen its agents yet
store.workSaved: Saved: new orders follow this choice
store.workRule: New orders follow this choice. Orders already given stay with the agency.
store.newPricesText: The current prices stay until you answer. Accept, or end the contract.
store.givenHelp: The work and the products. An order goes to the agency by its first product; a product given to nobody stays with your team.
store.pricesHelp: Set by the agency. A change waits for your “yes”.
store.theirAgentsHelp: Chosen by the agency. They only see the orders you give it, from the agency’s space.
store.monthText: Counted by Pilotix for {{m}}: what you owe the agency with its prices.
store.paymentsHelp: The agency asks to be paid for a month. You pay outside Pilotix, then click “Paid”.
store.codeTextAll: Give this code to a confirmation agency or a marketer: they send you a request, you accept it.

private: Your data stays yours: the Pilotix team does not see inside your agency.

fact.help: Each seller this month: their orders and what your prices make. You ask for the payment, the seller pays outside Pilotix and clicks « Paid », then you click « Money received ».

users.someSellersSub: tick the sellers, then each one’s products

mk.name: Your marketer space’s name
mk.addText: Your marketer space is free. Pilotix checks it before it works with stores.
mk.signupText: You run your sellers’ ads: your ad sets, their results and your payments in one place, with your team. Free: Pilotix checks your space before it starts.
mk.private: Your data stays yours: the Pilotix team does not see inside your space.
mk.sellersHelp: The stores whose ads you run. Open one to see its numbers, your prices and who works for it.
mk.addSellerText: Type the store’s code (the seller finds it in Settings or Marketers). They get your request, choose the products and accept it.
mk.notVerifiedYet: Pilotix has not checked your space yet: you can send requests afterwards.
mk.alreadyActive: You already work for this store.
mk.storeAsks: This store wants you to run its ads:
mk.agentsHelp: They see the ad sets the store gives them, from your space.
mk.chooseAgentsText: Tick the people of your team who work for this seller. Their products are chosen in Users.
mk.noAgentText: Nobody: choose who works for this store.
mk.noTeamYet: Nobody in your team for this work. Add marketers in

mk.endTextStore: The marketer will no longer see your ads. Their ad sets stay with you: give them to someone else.
mk.monthLead: Your team’s ad sets at this seller, this month: their spend, what they brought in, and what your prices make.
mk.pickText: The Ads page shows one seller at a time. Open the one you want (you can also choose it at the top of the page).

ph.perDelivered: The delivered orders your ad sets brought (your share).
